research_policy: Repository evidence first; external research only for a load-bearing decision or candidate relation.

external_claim_cards.title: Canadian Immunization Guide: Contraindications and precautions
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Mild illness does not require vaccine deferral; confirmed anaphylaxis to the vaccine or a component is a contraindication.

external_claim_cards.title: Safe Sleep Week
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Place an infant alone on the back on a firm, flat, separate sleep surface without soft items.

external_claim_cards.title: Dehydration and diarrhea in children
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Use oral rehydration solution for mild dehydration rather than plain or sugary drinks.

external_claim_cards.title: Oral ondansetron for gastroenteritis-related vomiting
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: A single oral ondansetron dose can facilitate oral rehydration in eligible children with vomiting and mild-to-moderate dehydration or failed oral rehydration.

external_claim_cards.title: Constipation in children
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Polyethylene glycol 3350 is used for disimpaction followed by maintenance and can be used long term in children.

external_claim_cards.issuing_organization: Choosing Wisely Canada / Canadian Association of General Surgeons
external_claim_cards.title: General Surgery recommendations
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Watchful waiting is safe for carefully selected asymptomatic or minimally symptomatic inguinal hernias; worsening symptoms can lead to elective repair.

external_claim_cards.title: Emergency Medicine recommendations
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Do not obtain ankle radiographs when the Ottawa ankle rules are negative.

external_claim_cards.title: Acute Trauma to the Ankle appropriateness criteria
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: MRI and ultrasound are not routine first imaging tests when Ottawa ankle rule criteria are negative; advanced imaging is reserved for specific later questions.

external_claim_cards.title: Consensus guideline: Management of testicular germ cell cancer
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Initial evaluation of a suspicious testicular mass includes scrotal ultrasonography and serum tumour markers.

external_claim_cards.title: Guideline for cryptorchidism
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Refer persistent cryptorchidism by six months corrected age; routine imaging is unnecessary and may mislead.

external_claim_cards.issuing_organization: Centre for Addiction and Mental Health
external_claim_cards.title: Detecting and assessing suicidality
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: A high-risk patient requires a safe secure setting while emergency psychiatric consultation or transfer is arranged.

external_claim_cards.title: Guidelines for bipolar disorder
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Multiple antimanic monotherapies and combinations are guideline-supported first-line treatments for acute mania.

external_claim_cards.issuing_organization: Canadian Coalition for Seniors' Mental Health
external_claim_cards.title: National guideline for delirium
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Identify and correct reversible causes while maintaining supportive physiologic and least-restrictive safety care.

external_claim_cards.issuing_organization: Canadian Research Initiative in Substance Matters
external_claim_cards.title: Management of opioid use disorder: 2024 update
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Buprenorphine and methadone are both standard first-line opioid agonist treatments; slow-release oral morphine is second line.

external_claim_cards.issuing_organization: Centre for Addiction and Mental Health
external_claim_cards.title: Canadian opioid use disorder guidance
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Medication selection must be individualized across buprenorphine, methadone, slow-release oral morphine, and other appropriate options.

external_claim_cards.issuing_organization: Association of Faculties of Medicine of Canada
external_claim_cards.title: Primer on Population Health, Chapter 6
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Sensitivity and specificity are test properties, while predictive values change with disease prevalence; likelihood ratios update pretest odds.

external_claim_cards.issuing_organization: Association of Faculties of Medicine of Canada
external_claim_cards.title: Primer on Population Health, Chapter 5
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Absolute risk reduction is the control risk minus treated risk and NNT is its reciprocal; baseline risk therefore affects NNT.

external_claim_cards.issuing_organization: International Pain and Spine Intervention Society
external_claim_cards.title: Emergency protocol for local anesthetic systemic toxicity
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Early LAST features include metallic taste, perioral numbness, and confusion; vasovagal reactions more typically feature bradycardia and hypotension.

external_claim_cards.title: Guideline for valvular heart disease
external_claim_cards.normalized_proposition: Echocardiography is central to valve characterization; ECG, radiography, biomarkers, CT, and CMR answer complementary rather than identical questions.
